description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractConnectivityCommandStrategy' which serves as a base for strategies handling 'ConnectivityCommand' objects within a connectivity messaging persistence context. It includes methods for validation, metadata calculation, and exception handling related to connectivity commands.

classes.name: AbstractConnectivityCommandStrategy
classes.description: An abstract class providing common functionality for strategies handling 'ConnectivityCommand' objects, including validation and exception handling.

methods.name: AbstractConnectivityCommandStrategy
methods.description: Constructor initializing the strategy with the class of the command it handles.

methods.name: isDefined
methods.description: Indicates that the command is always considered defined.

methods.name: calculateRelativeMetadata
methods.description: Calculates optional relative metadata for a given connection and command; returns empty in this implementation.

methods.name: notAccessible
methods.description: Creates a 'ConnectionNotAccessibleException' with headers and connection ID.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a connectivity command against a connection, returning an optional exception if validation fails.

methods.name: handleValidationException
methods.description: Handles exceptions during validation, logs info, and returns an optional 'DittoRuntimeException'.

methods.name: toDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Converts a Throwable into a 'DittoRuntimeException' with context-specific details.
